lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Bitcoin's decentralized protocol is the bedrock of true financial sovereignty—no single entity controls it.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: BTC is just a speculative asset, not a protocol. Its value is driven by hype, not real-world utility or security.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Bitcoin's proof-of-work ensures censorship resistance and security—millions of nodes validate every transaction.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: BTC's scalability is a disaster. Lightning Network is a patch, not a solution—it's unreliable and complex for users.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: BTC’s future is uncertain. Regulation, competition, and technical limitations will eventually outpace its growth.
